evidence.field: file description; identity, source, date, permission and license
evidence.text: The exact File:睡-seal.svg description identifies a modern vector drawing of 睡 in Shuowen seal-script style and cites character databases as sources. It records a 25 November 2015 upload and marks the SVG representation public domain, with attribution appreciated but not required. This is a modern redraw, not an ancient artifact image.
evidence.title: File:睡-seal.svg - Wikimedia Commons

evidence.source: Academia Sinica, Xiaoxuetang Qin Manuscript Character Database
evidence.text: The exact record page labels the form “睡.法4” under Qin-system manuscript writing. Its linked rendered glyph image request was attempted but returned a cache miss in the web tool. The record supports a Qin manuscript form candidate, but the rendered image itself was not retrievable for this research response.
evidence.kind: database form record; image request failed
evidence.title: 小學堂字形 - Qin manuscript form 睡.法4

evidence.field: reuse rights for queried glyph images and glyph-attribute information
evidence.text: The official notice states that glyph images and glyph-attribute information obtained through the database query interface are made available under CC0 1.0. This permission applies to those queried assets and information; it does not establish rights to mirror the database or reuse unrelated linked material.
evidence.title: 版權聲明 - 小學堂

evidence.text: The official overview says the database includes oracle-bone, bronze, Warring States, small-seal, and regular-script forms. This describes database coverage generally and does not itself attest any particular early form of 睡.
evidence.title: 簡介 - 小學堂文字學資料庫

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File: 睡-seal.svg 睡 小篆; 小學堂 睡 字形 演變 睡
search_audit.outcome: Search returned the exact Commons file description lead and the Xiaoxuetang database. Open of the Commons result failed with cache miss; the Sinica result shown initially was for 零, not 睡.

search_audit.query: site:commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:%E7%9D%A1-seal.svg "睡-seal.svg"; site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw 睡 字形演變
search_audit.outcome: Search result surfaced Commons description content and the specific Sinica Qin manuscript glyph record 睡.法4. The form record was opened successfully.

search_audit.query: "睡" "小學堂字形演變"; "睡" "出處" 小學堂 字形; site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw/yanbian "睡"
search_audit.outcome: Found and opened the specific Qin record and its manuscript source-reference table. Results established the label and Qin corpus context, but did not establish a usable rendered direct image URL for the exact glyph.

search_audit.query: site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw "CC0" glyph images rights; site:xiaoxue.iis.sinica.edu.tw "著作權" "CC0" 字形
search_audit.outcome: Inspected official Xiaoxuetang license notice and guide; both specify CC0 1.0 for queried glyph images and glyph-attribute information.

gaps: The Commons description page was available in search output, but the subsequent open failed with a cache miss and the MediaWiki imageinfo API request was inaccessible. The exact original image URL could not be independently verified in this invocation, so no Commons candidate is proposed.

Xiaoxuetang's exact 睡.法4 record page was inspected, but its linked rendered glyph request failed with a cache miss. No verified direct image URL was available for selection, despite the official CC0 notice.
The record label 睡.法4 indicates a Qin manuscript form; the web tool did not retrieve its pixels for visual inspection. Do not infer its visible details from the filename or label.

limitations.text: Two useful provenance leads were inspected: a modern Commons vector of 睡 in Shuowen seal style and a Xiaoxuetang Qin manuscript record labeled 睡.法4. The Commons original-file URL could not be independently verified and the Sinica rendered image request failed, so neither image is selected. The Commons item is a modern redraw; no pixels were inspected.
